The state's interest is best described as a fee simple determinable (A). Strictly, the "re-enter" language to the grantor is the classic mark of a fee simple subject to condition subsequent (B), but your note rules B out. Of the two remaining options, D needs an executory interest held by a third party, and here the only future interest is the grantor's own, so D doesn't fit.

CONFIDENCE: 50
